A function pointer (`fn(i16) -> i16`) chosen at run time
notes: A call through a cell holding an address can be built with self-modifying code, as variable indexing is.

CARDIAC has no stack and each function's locals and return address are fixed cells, so a recursive call needs a software stack of its own (an array and self-modifying loads); possible, but slow and costly in cells, and a loop does the same.
As for direct recursion: it needs a software stack, since each function's cells are fixed.
A call in tail position needs no stack: the compiler could turn it into a jump back to the start, as a loop.
